title: Choose the Night Atlas composition
question: Same world. Three ways the first viewport can work. Lock one; the build must match it.

options.label: Open sky
options.thesis: The tree is the whole sky. Select a star, add at the compass, read the catalog slip.
options.viewport: Full-bleed navy canvas. Portrait-stars on generation bands. Selected Mira Solano with four compass actions. Slim instrument column left, profile slip right.
options.risk: The profile slip can steal the sky if it grows too wide.

options.label: Focus and place
options.thesis: Adding a person is the first viewport: one constellation isolated, the catalog slip already open.
options.viewport: Focus mode. Mira large and haloed. Other relatives dim. Add-person slip on the right. Mini-map of the full sky lower left.
options.risk: Can feel like a form-first app if the slip dominates the constellation.

options.label: Find then strike
options.thesis: A dense atlas you search. Jump, highlight, then act.
options.viewport: A larger multi-generation sky. Command palette open. Noor Solano struck gold. Filter chips and a circular mini-map.
options.risk: Density plus overlay can hide the compass add actions that make the product work.
